content.title: USA vs Belgium prediction: Odds, picks & stats
content.text: Richard Parry 6 days agoThe United States host Belgium at Mercedes-Benz Stadium this weekend in a high-profile international friendly. This matchup serves as a crucial World Cup measuring stick for both nations. Mauricio Pochettino wants to build momentum on home soil ahead of the 2026 tournament. Meanwhile, Belgium are eager to extend their impressive nine-game unbeaten streak.Consequently, this fixture offers plenty of intrigue for bettors. Both squads are navigating significant injury absences. This creates a fascinating tactical battle where emerging talents have the chance to secure World Cup roster spots. They will look to capitalize on any defensive vulnerabilities. Read on for our complete USA vs Belgium prediction.Best Bets & PredictionsBased on recent international form and historical head-to-head data, here are our top betting recommendations. We are particularly confident in a high-scoring affair. This confidence stems from Belgium’s immense attacking volume and the consistent scoring record of the USMNT at home.Our PredictionOdds & SportsbookConfidenceWhy We’re Backing ItBoth Teams To Score-163 @ Bet365 (61.9%)The USMNT average 2.04 goals per game and have scored in 87% of their home matches. Chat available at ncpgambling.org/chatForm & Match ContextWhile friendlies often carry a risk of heavy rotation, the looming final roster deadline gives this fixture genuine competitive weight. Therefore, our USA vs Belgium prediction must account for these high stakes.The USMNT enter the match boasting an impressive recent record. They have won four of their last six games, scoring 12 goals in the process. However, they have only managed one clean sheet during this run. This highlights a tendency to play open, entertaining matches.Conversely, Belgium arrive in Atlanta in dominant form. Domenico Tedesco’s side remain unbeaten in their last nine outings. They have scored 24 goals in their previous six matches alone. This translates to a terrifying average of four goals per game.Despite their dominance, Belgium have conceded in two of their last six fixtures. This slight defensive vulnerability should give the American attackers plenty of encouragement. Ultimately, the tactical pattern points toward an open game with multiple scoring opportunities.USA Team NewsPochettino faces a challenging selection puzzle ahead of this weekend. The USMNT head coach has lost several key figures to injury. Most notably, holding midfielder Tyler Adams is ruled out with a minor issue.Furthermore, full-back Sergiño Dest and forward Haji Wright are also unavailable. These absences severely compromise the defensive and attacking depth of the squad. Consequently, players like Tanner Tessmann could step up to anchor the midfield.Despite these setbacks, the American attack remains potent. Christian Pulisic and Weston McKennie return to the squad after missing the November window. Both players are firing at the club level. Additionally, the enigmatic Gio Reyna has been included and will be desperate to prove his worth.Belgium Team NewsBelgium are also navigating a significant injury crisis of their own. Record goalscorer Romelu Lukaku has withdrawn from the squad to focus on his fitness. This leaves a major gap at the focal point of their attack.Additionally, Leandro Trossard and Hans Vanaken have been ruled out. These absences reduce their creative options in the final third. However, bettors should not sound the alarm just yet.The European side still retains terrifying attacking depth. Several young call-ups will be eager to impress ahead of the World Cup. This rotation shifts the attacking burden, creating a more unpredictable front line that will test the American defense from multiple angles.Potential Match-WinnersWith several headline names missing, the attacking burden shifts to players eager to cement their World Cup status. Here are the key players who could swing this USA vs Belgium prediction:Christian Pulisic (USA) – The AC Milan star returns to the squad in excellent club form. He remains the undisputed creative hub of this American side. His ability to isolate defenders makes him a constant threat.Lois Openda (Belgium) – In the absence of Lukaku, the RB Leipzig striker should lead the line. His explosive pace and clinical finishing make him a prime candidate for anytime goalscorer props.Weston McKennie (USA) – The Juventus midfielder brings crucial energy and late runs into the box. His aerial threat on set-pieces could exploit a rotated Belgian defense.Jeremy Doku (Belgium) – The dynamic winger has the ability to break open tight games. His direct dribbling will severely test an American backline missing Sergiño Dest.Head-to-HeadThese nations have met four times previously, with Belgium dominating the historical record. The European side has won three of those encounters. The United States secured their lone victory way back at the 1930 World Cup.Crucially for totals bettors, these fixtures have averaged exactly three goals per game. Furthermore, 75% of their meetings produced over 2.5 goals. Their most recent clash came during the 2014 World Cup, where Belgium secured a thrilling 2-1 victory in extra time.All-Time MeetingsDateScoreCompetitionJuly 1, 2014Belgium 0-0 USA (Belgium win 2-1 AET)World Cup 2014May 30, 2013USA 2-4 BelgiumFriendlySeptember 6, 2011Belgium 1-0 USAFriendlyJuly 13, 1930USA 3-0 BelgiumWorld Cup 1930USA vs Belgium PredictionDespite the genuine home advantage for the United States, the sheer disparity in squad depth points toward an away victory. Belgium’s attack possesses too much movement and firepower, even without Romelu Lukaku. They should eventually overwhelm an American defense missing key midfield protection.Expect an open, entertaining game where both sides find the net. Ultimately, the visitors should pull away in the second half. Our top pick for this USA vs Belgium prediction is Both Teams to Score at -163 with Bet365.
